snippet.title: Intruder Steam Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Intruder has finally come to STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/518150?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=launch&utm_content=trailer

The ultimate spy-vs-guards simulator. Carefully sneak your way to the objective as Intruders or use the wide variety of tactical gadgets to trap your opponents as Guards. Intruder allows for stealth, teamwork, and environmental interactions never before seen in a multiplayer game.

Buy Intruder: https://store.steampowered.com/app/518150?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=video&utm_campaign=launch&utm_content=trailer
